04 / SAME TRANSFER. AFTER THE CRASH.

SAVE SIGNED BYTES -> SEND RESEARCH 002 -> EXIT 74
                                            |
                         RESTART -> FINALIZED LOOKUP
                                            |
                    SAME SIGNATURE -> TASK 003 -> DONE

The second payment was dispatched before the deliberate exit. Its receipt was not yet persisted. Restart reconciled that exact signature and verified finalized bytes, fee and USDC balance deltas. A repeated complete run left the transaction outbox unchanged: zero new signatures or transfers.

Signed bytes persist before broadcast. A transport error keeps the transaction held. Reads back off on public-RPC rate limits; an expired uncertain outcome stops for inspection instead of signing a replacement.

05 / CHECK THE BOUNDARY

On actual mainnet accounts, preflight rejected one microUSDC over the remaining cap and a different delegate. Owner revocation finalized; a subsequent worker preflight also rejected. These three negative checks are signed simulations, not broadcast failed transactions. No failed-test fees were spent.

The downloaded mainnet executable separately passes 15 local LiteSVM checks using fixture balances. The program is upgradeable; this is not an independent BATTERY audit.
